R1.description: A work item created under 2.15.0 (except a legacy item imported and later promoted) records, in its state and in the verdict's own transaction, one local or one external round per recorded APPROVE or REVISE of each review stage, and nothing else changes

R2.description: next-action's snapshot reports plan_local, plan_external, implementation_local and implementation_external (a number, or None when not recorded), and plan, implementation and current are unchanged

R3.description: Orchestration Protocol 1.5, additive: version constant, schema, specification and a stated compatibility rule for a 1.4 reader

R4.description: Release 2.15.0: manifest and manager block, release constant, release history and the downgrade posture
